subject: Great meeting at AI Summit  follow up on inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeailabs.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at AI Summit  follow up on inference needs

Hi Samantha 

It was great to meet you at the AI Summit yesterday. I enjoyed our quick chat about EdgeAI Labs' low-latency inference use cases for real-time video analytics  love the work you're doing. As promised, I wanted to follow up with a few bullets and propose a short discovery call to understand your workload and constraints in more detail.

Quick recap from our conversation: 
- Primary workload: live video inference (frame rate ~15-30fps), short prompts per frame, strict p99 latency SLOs (~100ms)
- Current pain: erratic latency on cloud GPUs, high egress costs for embeddings, difficulty with model version rollouts
- Interested in: dedicated inference pools, KV/prefix caching, and hybrid private deployment options

Would you be available for a 30-minute discovery call this week or early next week? I can include Logan (our performance SE) to dig into latency/throughput tradeoffs.

Suggested times:
- Wed 3/17: 10:00 11:00 PT or 14:00 15:00 PT
- Thu 3/18: 09:00 12:00 PT

Attached a short 1-pager we hand out at events that maps typical patterns to configuration suggestions. No heavy commitment  just to help frame the discussion.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
https://redwood.com

Attachment: 20270315-Redwood-OnePager.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeailabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great meeting at AI Summit  follow up on inference needs

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the follow up  great to meet you as well. Tom (cc'd) and I are definitely interested in digging into this. We're currently evaluating options for both cloud-hosted and on-prem inference for a pilot later this quarter.

30 minutes sounds good  we can do Thu 3/18 at 10:00 PT. If Logan can join to talk throughput/latency tradeoffs that would be helpful.

Also would be great to see examples of SLA targets you've met for similar customers, and any notes on cost delta between hosted vs dedicated.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform | EdgeAI Labs
samantha.lee@edgeailabs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeailabs.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@edgeailabs.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great meeting at AI Summit  follow up on inference needs

Thanks for the time today  really productive. Looping our notes and next steps below. Attaching the brief deck Logan referenced and a starter mutual action plan (MAP).

Call recap (high level):
- Pilot scope: 2 models (frame-level classifier + short-context reranker), peak concurrent streams ~120, steady-state ~40
- SLO/Latency: target p95 <60ms, p99 <120ms for inference path
- Data/Networking: models will run on a VPC-connected dedicated cluster; minimal model updates initially

Action items / Next steps:
1) Redwood to share:
   - Pilot config options (dedicated vs hosted burst) + estimated cost ranges (see attached MAP)
   - Performance benchmark summary from similar customers (included in deck)
   - Short checklist for security/compliance items we typically need for VPC/private deployments
   - Proposed pilot timeline (2 3 weeks for onboarding + 4 6 week pilot)
2) EdgeAI:
   - Confirm internal stakeholders for SRE and security (Tom and one more?)
   - Share anonymized sample load profile (frames/sec, avg token counts)

Proposed follow-up: 30-min technical deep dive w/ SRE + Logan next Tue 3/23 or Wed 3/24. Let me know which works and I'll send an invite.

Attachments:
- 20270318-Redwood-EdgeAI-Deck.pdf
- 20270318-EdgeAI-MAP.xlsx

Thanks  looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeailabs.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@edgeailabs.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in  pilot timeline and next steps

Hi Samantha 

Circling back on the MAP and our proposed technical deep dive. Wanted to check whether this is still a priority for EdgeAI over the next 2 4 weeks, or if timing has shifted. No worries either way  just trying to align calendars so we don't ping you too often.

If it's helpful, I can: 
- Share a short latency comparison matrix for hosted vs dedicated configs tailored to your expected load, or
- Schedule the 30-min deep dive with Logan + your SRE for next week (Tue 3/30 or Wed 3/31), or
- Re-queue and touch base in early April if this isn't the right moment.

Would love any signal on priority/timing so we can keep resources aligned on our side.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@edgeailabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checking in  pilot timeline and next steps

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the nudge  we're still very interested, but our product roadmap shifted and the pilot has moved to the back of Q2. Can we pause on scheduling for now and revisit first week of April to lock a date? If you have the latency comparison matrix, feel free to send it over  that may help us narrow the target configuration before the deep dive.

Appreciate it  
Samantha
